en.title: Should Your Last Night in China Be in Your Departure City?
en.headline: Should You Return to Your China Departure City the Day Before Your Flight?
en.description: Decide whether to position for an international flight the night before or travel from another Chinese city on departure day by checking ticket protection, airports, cutoffs, fallbacks and real cost.
en.heroAlt: International travellers with luggage checking a departure board at an airport in mainland China
en.featuredLinkLabel: Plan the last night before your flight

zh.title: 中国行程最后一晚要住在国际航班出发城市吗？
zh.headline: 国际航班前一天，要不要先回到中国境内的出发城市？
zh.description: 从联程保障、机场位置、值机截止、后备交通和真实成本，判断应提前一晚到达国际航班出发城市，还是可以当天从中国另一座城市前往。
zh.heroAlt: 携带行李的国际旅客在中国大陆机场查看航班出发信息
zh.navTitle: 国际航班前一晚怎么安排
zh.featuredLinkLabel: 判断是否需要提前回到出发城市

ko.headline: 중국 출국 전날, 국제선 출발 도시로 미리 돌아가야 할까?
